Lazulix.Biography: A phoenix that resurrected not from fire, but ice. Through a magical rock, the ancient bird commands the power to create lands of snow and frost. Its vast power drew the intrepid adventurers to hunt it, but none succeeded due to its elusiveness and harsh habitat. But as war spread throughout the land, the legendary bird could no longer remain hidden. Furious of the denizens' warmongering ways, it vowed to bury the chaos under a relentless blizzard so that life in Narcia may start anew.

Lil Nick.Biography:
Lil' Nick sulked and pouted when he was told to stay home. The moment the old man vanished into the snowstorm, Lil' Nick turned around and rummaged for his hidden stash. With a bell in one hand and an overfilled sack in the other, he left the homely cabin while declaring: 
"Just you wait! I'll show you how festive I can be!"
